_readme: Merge the 'hooks' block into %USERPROFILE%\.claude\settings.json so every Claude Code session shows up as a bot. Change the path if XrShift lives somewhere else. The app must be running with --api; when it is not, the hook does nothing and takes about a quarter of a second. PostToolUse is what turns a bot from 'needs you' back to 'working' after you approve something; leave it out and that bot stays amber until it finishes.
